context: Aoi shows Hina-young a new product line at the cafe.
purpose: Adult and teen reviewing business product.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ひな、新しい製品、紹介するね。
lines.en: Hina, let me show you something new we just added to the menu.
lines.style: Warm and inviting, like opening a small gift. Gentle lean forward. Voice carries the pleasure of sharing something carefully chosen. Soft, unhurried.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 最新のメニュー、楽しみ!
lines.en: Oh, a new menu? I can't wait to see it!
lines.style: Bright and eager, but not loud—genuine excitement that bounces lightly. Eyes up. Quick breath on the opening, then a forward roll into the question. Genuine curiosity, not performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 日々、お客さんの反応、気にしてる。
lines.en: I pay attention to what customers really think of things. It matters to me.
lines.style: Thoughtful and genuine. A small pause before speaking, like she's weighing what's honest. Quiet confidence—not defensive, just honest about caring. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: スタッフの皆、頑張ってますね。
lines.en: Everyone on the team is working really hard.
lines.style: Observant and warm. A note of admiration underneath. Said like she's noticing something true. Soft, not gushing—just a quiet acknowledgement of effort.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 体制、しっかり整えてる。
lines.en: We've built a really solid system here.
lines.style: Grounded and assured. Speaking from quiet pride in the work. Even tone, no self-doubt. The voice of someone who's helped build something and trusts it.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 気分、すごくいい雰囲気!
lines.en: The energy in here feels amazing right now.
lines.style: Bright, open, and fully present. A small smile audible in the voice. Light, buoyant—like she's noticing something good happening in real time. Quick, warm cadence.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: It makes me really happy to finally put this into action.
lines.style: Tender and genuine. A softness at the edges. Like relief and satisfaction arriving together. Warm exhale on 'happy'—this is something she's been wanting to do. Slower pace.
